entities.name: Henri of Savoy, Duke of Nemours
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henri of Savoy, called originally Marquis de Saint-Sorlin, was the son of Jacques of Savoy and Anna d'Este, the widow of François de Lorraine, Duke of Guise. He succeeded his brother Charles Emmanuel as Duke of Nemours.
